shared_elements: repeated motifs organised into horizontal bands or rows
museum display context with modern signage
justification: The only real correspondence is the organisation of small schematic motifs into stacked horizontal registers and the presence of curved horn- or crescent-like shapes, together with the shared modern museum setting. Everything else diverges: A is red pigment painted flat on a pale plaster wall with actual animal bone and horn cores attached, while B is a single upright stone block covered in deep, sculptural relief carving with discs and a modelled head, so the media, scale and format have nothing in common.
